I will correct your mistakes and also guide you step by step. Practice with me and then you will see for yourself how quickly your English improves.] Speaker A: अगर आप भी हिंदी के through confidently English बोलना सीखना चाहते हो तो रोज़ बस 10-15 मिनट AI English teacher Vani के साथ practice करो। अभी SpeakEasy App download करो और English बोलने का confidence build करो। [If you also want to learn to speak English confidently through Hindi, then practice with AI English teacher Vani for just 10-15 minutes every day.
